codeReview.summary: The retry-actions fixture wiring is implemented and test-covered, but the queue-loading half of the feature is incomplete: the authenticated queue API never reads a fixture parameter, so `queueFixture=loading` cannot deterministically alter server behavior on the real authenticated Queue tab as required.

issues.description: The authenticated queue route does not parse or use any `fixture`/`queueFixture` query parameter; it only accepts `restaurantId`, `page`, and `pageSize`. As a result, `?tab=queue&queueFixture=loading` cannot trigger the intended deterministic loading-mode behavior on the real authenticated surface, so the feature's second requirement is not actually implemented end-to-end.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The queue-loading validation path depends on authenticated `/email-delivery?tab=queue&queueFixture=loading`, but the queue API contract documented in code/shared state does not mention fixture support and the route currently ignores it.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `src/app/api/ops/email-queue/route.ts` querySchema only defines `restaurantId`, `page`, and `pageSize`, while the feature handoff claims `queueFixture=loading` is available on the authenticated Queue tab.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker marked the queue-loading requirement as satisfied based on a transient UI capture, but the transcript shows no inspection of the authenticated queue API route that would have revealed the fixture parameter is unsupported server-side.

summary: Review failed: retry fixture hardening looks correct, but `queueFixture=loading` is not wired through the authenticated queue API, so deterministic queue-loading observability is not actually implemented on the real surface.
